description: Live non-custodial liquidity, as positions an agent can actually trade against. Each row carries the strategy hash, network, pair, tokens, settled volume and a `quote_eligible` flag, meaning the position is router-attached and its network has a quote route. It does NOT mean the position will quote: a maker can still gate it. Use this before a swap to find a real on-chain counterparty, or to survey where liquidity sits. Filter by network and by pair. Free, no key, no custody.

chain.description: Network key, e.g. "base" or "ethereum". Defaults to every network.

pair.description: Pair filter. Either an exact pair such as "USDC/USDT", or a substring such as "USDC" or "WETH" which matches any pair containing it, or a network name, or part of a strategy hash.

quote_ready.description: True returns positions on a network that has a quote route, which is the quote_eligible set. False returns the positions that do not, which are usually on networks with no quote RPC. Neither guarantees a price: a maker can still gate a position, and around 6 in 10 sampled positions answer "Strategy is gated".
